hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang, who had said he was stepping away for a moment to relieve himself, returned a quarter-hour later. Something felt suspicious, and I narrowed my eyes.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang, who had said he was stepping away for a moment to relieve himself, returned fifteen minutes later. Something felt suspicious, and I narrowed my eyes.

hunks.baseline: “But it took you a whole quarter-hour. Could it be that—”
hunks.sol: “But it took you fifteen minutes. Could it be that—”

hunks.baseline: “This old man has stamina to spare.”
hunks.sol: “This old man has virility to spare.”

hunks.baseline: How much stamina did he have if it took him fifteen minutes to pee?
hunks.sol: How virile did you have to be to spend fifteen minutes pissing?

hunks.baseline: At that point, wasn’t it less a stream and more a fire hose?
hunks.sol: At that point, it wasn’t a stream. It was a fire hose.

hunks.baseline: When I stared at him in disbelief, Jeok Cheongang raised his eyes.
hunks.sol: When I stared at him in disbelief, Jeok Cheongang glared at me.

hunks.baseline: It was an issue I had never once considered before.
hunks.sol: It was something I had never once considered before.

hunks.baseline: “I, Jin Wikyung, a junior of Murim, pay my respects to the Fire King Jeok Cheongang, whose fame resounds throughout the world.”
hunks.sol: “This humble junior, Jin Wikyung, pays his respects to the Fire King Jeok Cheongang, whose fame resounds throughout the world.”

hunks.baseline: After scanning Jin Wikyung from head to toe, Jeok Cheongang nodded as though he had figured something out.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang looked Jin Wikyung up and down, then nodded as if he had figured it out.

hunks.baseline: “Teach your son properly. The boy is young, yet he’s already getting hotheaded and causing trouble. His manners are terrible, too.”
hunks.sol: “Raise your son properly. The boy’s young, but he’s already hotheaded and causing trouble. His manners are terrible, too.”

hunks.baseline: “Don’t joke around. I understand wanting to look young, but getting too greedy will bring down Heaven’s punishment.”
hunks.sol: “Don’t joke around. I understand wanting to look young, but if you get too greedy, Heaven will punish you.”

hunks.baseline: “By any chance, how old are you?”
hunks.sol: “How old are you, by any chance?”

hunks.baseline: “I turned thirty-six this year.”
hunks.sol: “Now that the year has turned, I’m thirty-six.”

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang muttered with an expression of disbelief.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang muttered in disbelief.

hunks.baseline: His face was, admittedly, somewhat—quite a lot, actually—more weathered than his age suggested. I had mistaken him for my father at first, too.
hunks.sol: Admittedly, his face was somewhat—quite a lot, actually—more weathered than his age suggested. Even I had mistaken him for my father at first.

hunks.baseline: At least his hair was still thick, but there seemed to be no solution for a face that had taken a 160-kilometer-per-hour fastball from time.
hunks.sol: At least his hair was still thick, but there was no cure for a face that had taken a 160-kilometer-per-hour fastball from time itself.

hunks.baseline: “It’s all right. A man is judged by his abilities. You’ve got a pretty wife and adorable children, so what more do you need? Heh heh.”
hunks.sol: “It’s all right. What matters in a man is his ability. You’ve got a pretty wife and adorable children, so what more do you need? Heh heh.”

hunks.baseline: In modern times, that would only be around the age when people started thinking about marriage. But in Murim, where early marriage was common, thirty-six was old enough to have grandchildren.
hunks.sol: In modern times, that would only be around the age when people started thinking seriously about marriage. But in Murim, where early marriage was common, thirty-six was old enough to have grandchildren.

hunks.baseline: The single Jin Wikyung answered shortly.
hunks.sol: The bachelor Jin Wikyung gave a terse answer.

hunks.baseline: This silence lasted a while. The Fire King furrowed and relaxed his brow several times, flaring his nostrils before finally heaving a deep sigh.
hunks.sol: This silence ran a little long. The Fire King furrowed his brow, relaxed it, then flared his nostrils before finally heaving a deep sigh.

hunks.baseline: I snorted quietly. It was a feast day like this one—how could there be no alcohol? There was enough of it lying around to drown in.
hunks.sol: I let out a quiet laugh. It was a feast day, after all. What kind of feast would it be without alcohol? There was enough of it lying around to drown in.

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang’s eyes went round.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang’s eyes widened.

hunks.baseline: A mood was like a spark. Once it went out, it was difficult to set alight again.
hunks.sol: A mood was like a spark. Once it went out, it was difficult to rekindle.

hunks.baseline: No—in the presence of the Fire King, it had begun blazing even more fiercely.
hunks.sol: No—in the presence of the Fire King, it blazed even more fiercely.

hunks.baseline: “Drink! I said let’s drink!”
hunks.sol: “Drink! Come on, let’s drink!”

hunks.baseline: “When the Fire King gets flustered, he goes Right Fire King, Left Fire King![^2]”
hunks.sol: “When the Fire King gets flustered, he goes Right Fire King, Left Fire King![^1]”

hunks.baseline: [^2]: This puns on *jwa-wang-u-wang*, a Korean expression for being flustered or running around in confusion; *jwa* and *u* mean “left” and “right,” while *wang* means “king.”
I didn’t know who that was, but that bastard had nearly put out the spark just now.
hunks.sol: I didn’t know who that was, but that bastard had nearly put out the spark.

hunks.baseline: At my glance, Hyuk Mujin, who had been standing by, quietly slipped away to hunt down the mood killer.
hunks.sol: At my signal, Hyuk Mujin, who had been standing by, quietly slipped away to hunt down the mood killer.

hunks.baseline: The name Jeok Cheongang, the Fire King, was practically a living legend.
hunks.sol: The name of the Fire King, Jeok Cheongang, was practically synonymous with living legend.

hunks.baseline: Moreover, his whereabouts had been unknown for decades, so most people had accepted his death as an established fact.
hunks.sol: Moreover, his whereabouts had been unknown for decades, so most people had long accepted his death as fact.

hunks.baseline: And now the Fire King, whom everyone had thought dead, had appeared—not in the Central Plains or Mount Jiuhua, but right here at the Jin Family of Taiyuan in Shanxi Province.
hunks.sol: And now the Fire King, whom everyone had thought dead, had appeared—not in the Central Plains or on Mount Jiuhua, but right here at the Jin Family of Taiyuan in Shanxi Province.

hunks.baseline: Perhaps this was what it would be like if a legendary singer once called the Emperor of Pop came back from the dead.
hunks.sol: Perhaps this was what it would be like if the legendary singer once called the Emperor of Pop came back from the dead.

hunks.baseline: —Youngest.
hunks.sol: —My youngest.

hunks.baseline: The only people who could carry on a lengthy conversation with the eccentric Jeok Cheongang were Cheongpung and me. But Cheongpung was impossible to predict, so in the end, I had no choice but to act as the messenger.
hunks.sol: The only people who could hold a lengthy conversation with the eccentric Jeok Cheongang were Cheongpung and me. But there was no telling where Cheongpung’s thoughts might wander, so in the end, I had no choice but to act as the messenger.

hunks.baseline: “Is there somewhere uncomfortable?”
hunks.sol: “Are you uncomfortable?”

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang glared at the wine crock beside him. Quite a bit of time had passed, yet hardly any of it had been emptied.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang glared at the wine crock beside him. Quite a bit of time had passed, yet hardly any of it was gone.

hunks.baseline: It wasn’t that he disliked alcohol. He simply hadn’t had enough time to drink.
hunks.sol: It wasn’t that he disliked alcohol. He simply hadn’t had time to drink.

hunks.baseline: There were people asking him to accept them as Disciples, Sect Leaders and merchants begging to host him as an honored guest.
hunks.sol: People kept asking him to accept them as Disciples, while Sect Leaders and merchants begged to host him as an honored guest.

hunks.baseline: *Was he a dol hareubang or something?[^1]*
hunks.sol: *Was he a dol hareubang or something?[^2]*

hunks.baseline: It was enough to make even the onlookers snicker. How much worse must it have been for the person at the center of it all?
hunks.sol: It was enough to make even the onlookers snicker. How much worse must it have been for the man at the center of it all?

hunks.baseline: Frankly, the fact that Jeok Cheongang had endured this much was impressive in itself.
hunks.sol: Frankly, given Jeok Cheongang’s personality, the fact that he had endured this much was impressive in itself.

hunks.baseline: “Why don’t we move somewhere I prepared in advance? It’s quieter there.”
hunks.sol: “Why don’t we move somewhere I prepared in advance? It’s quiet there.”

hunks.baseline: It was obvious that he hated noisy places and found people’s attention bothersome. That was probably why he had spent his entire life on Mount Jiuhua in the first place.
hunks.sol: It was obvious that he hated noisy places and found people’s attention bothersome. That was probably why he had spent his entire life on Mount Jiuhua.

hunks.baseline: In front of him, the owner of a merchant association with considerable influence in Shanxi Province was bowing and scraping.
hunks.sol: In front of him, the owner of one of Shanxi Province’s most influential merchant associations was bowing and scraping.

hunks.baseline: “Great Hero Jeok! I’ve heard all about your thunderous reputation throughout the world. When I was young, I admired you so much…”
hunks.sol: “Great Hero Jeok! I’ve long heard of your reputation, which shakes the entire world. When I was young, I admired you so much…”

hunks.baseline: “Yes. It’s something I acquired recently, but I suppose every item has its rightful owner.”
hunks.sol: “Yes. It’s something I acquired recently, but I suppose every item has its destined owner.”

hunks.baseline: The merchant took a small wooden box from inside his robe and opened the lid. A ring set with clear jade appeared inside.
hunks.sol: The merchant took a small wooden box from inside his robe and opened the lid. Inside was a ring set with clear jade.

hunks.baseline: The merchant waved his hands exaggeratedly.
hunks.sol: The merchant waved his hands dramatically.

hunks.baseline: A thousand silver nyang for a single ring. It was among the most expensive gifts the Jin Family of Taiyuan had received so far.
hunks.sol: A thousand silver nyang for a single ring. It ranked among the most expensive gifts the Jin Family of Taiyuan had received so far.

hunks.baseline: “Well, you’re giving it to me, so I’ll accept it gratefully. What was your name and where are you from?”
hunks.sol: “Well, since you’re giving it to me, I’ll accept it gratefully. Who are you, and where are you from?”

hunks.baseline: The merchant had been interrupted before he could even give his name, but he bowed as though he had received an honor.
hunks.sol: The merchant had been interrupted before he could even give his name, but he bowed as if he had received a great honor.

hunks.baseline: “Yes. We are trying to begin trade with the Hebei Peng Family, but it has been difficult.”
hunks.sol: “Yes. We are trying to begin trading with the Hebei Peng Family, but it has not been easy.”

hunks.baseline: The reason he had come to Jeok Cheongang, even after offering a token of sincerity that was anything but small.
hunks.sol: It was why he had sought out Jeok Cheongang even after offering a token of sincerity that was anything but small.

hunks.baseline: “The Peng Family. Who’s the Family Head these days?”
hunks.sol: “The Peng Family, huh? Who’s the Family Head these days?”

hunks.baseline: “This old man once had a drink with the Thunderbolt Saber King when I was young. All right, I understand.”
hunks.sol: “This old man once had a drink with the Thunderbolt Saber King in his younger days. All right, I understand.”

hunks.baseline: That was the end of the conversation. The merchant left, grinning from ear to ear, after setting down the wooden box.
hunks.sol: That was the end of the conversation. The merchant set down the wooden box and left with a grin stretching from ear to ear.

hunks.baseline: Beneath it lay a stack of bank drafts that had not been there moments ago.
hunks.sol: Beneath the box lay a stack of bank drafts that had not been there moments ago.

hunks.baseline: I took advantage of the merchant’s retreat to whisper to Jeok Cheongang.
hunks.sol: Once the merchant had withdrawn, I leaned closer and whispered to Jeok Cheongang.

hunks.baseline: As his title suggested, the Thunderbolt Saber King was one of the Ten Kings, a Supreme Peak master just like Jeok Cheongang.
hunks.sol: As his title suggested, he was one of the Ten Kings, a Supreme Peak master just like Jeok Cheongang.

hunks.baseline: He spoke of the Thunderbolt Saber King as though he had met an old neighborhood friend. Every time he did something like this, I was reminded just how extraordinary Jeok Cheongang was.
hunks.sol: He talked about the Thunderbolt Saber King as if he were some old neighborhood friend. Every time he did something like this, I was reminded all over again of just how extraordinary Jeok Cheongang was.

hunks.baseline: “I flattened that bastard’s nose back in the day.”
hunks.sol: “I flattened that bastard’s nose years ago.”

hunks.baseline: “I was having a drink with the Sword Saint when he barged in without a word and picked a fight. We went a few rounds, and I taught him a lesson.”
hunks.sol: “I was having a drink with the Sword Saint when he barged in without a word and picked a fight. We fought, and I taught him a lesson.”

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang furrowed his brows.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang furrowed his brow.

hunks.baseline: “What would I gain from associating with such an uncultured bastard? We never saw each other again after that.”
hunks.sol: “Why would I associate with an uncultured bastard like him? We never saw each other again after that.”

hunks.baseline: “Later, some strange rumor even started going around. They said that the Peng Family’s man and I had exchanged over a hundred moves, acknowledged each other, and withdrawn. The bastards from the Hebei Peng Family must have pulled some kind of trick.”
hunks.sol: “Later, some strange rumor even started going around. They said the Peng Family’s man and I had exchanged over a hundred moves before acknowledging each other and withdrawing. The bastards from the Hebei Peng Family must have pulled some kind of trick.”

hunks.baseline: “Th-then the Yangcheon Merchant Association can’t do business with the Hebei Peng Family, can they? Mentioning Great Hero Jeok’s name will only make things worse.”
hunks.sol: “Th-then the Yangcheon Merchant Association won’t be able to trade with the Hebei Peng Family, will they? Mentioning Great Hero Jeok’s name will only make things worse.”

hunks.baseline: “But you said you would help him trade with the Hebei Peng Family.”
hunks.sol: “But you said you’d help him trade with the Hebei Peng Family.”

hunks.baseline: “He asked me to meet him, so I met him. It’s also true that I had a drink with the Thunderbolt Saber King. Is there even a shred of falsehood in anything I said?”
hunks.sol: “He asked me to meet him, so I met him. It’s also true that I had a drink with the Thunderbolt Saber King. Was there even a shred of falsehood in anything this old man said?”

hunks.baseline: I wasn’t sure about that, but he certainly seemed to be missing even a shred of conscience.
hunks.sol: I wasn’t sure about that, but he certainly didn’t seem to possess even a shred of conscience.

hunks.baseline: His shamelessness was so impressive that I almost felt respect for him.
hunks.sol: His shamelessness was so impressive that I almost respected him for it.

hunks.baseline: He had more than one or two victims. The people who had believed Jeok Cheongang’s empty promises and offered him a “small token of sincerity” would soon realize that everything had been complete bullshit and pound the ground in despair.
hunks.sol: He had more than one or two victims. Before long, the people who had believed Jeok Cheongang’s empty promises and offered him a “small token of sincerity” would realize that it had all been complete bullshit and pound the ground in despair.

hunks.baseline: But there would be no victims.
hunks.sol: Not that any of the victims would come forward.

hunks.baseline: No one brave enough to come to the Fire King, Jeok Cheongang, and demand their gifts back existed.
hunks.sol: No one was brave enough to approach the Fire King, Jeok Cheongang, and demand their gifts back.

hunks.baseline: “Hmm. I’ll drop by one day.”
hunks.sol: “Hmm. I’ll stop by one day.”

hunks.baseline: That meant he would visit after he died and wandered the netherworld.
hunks.sol: Meaning after he died and found himself wandering the netherworld.

hunks.baseline: As I watched the various treasures, elixirs, and bank drafts piling up like a mountain, I realized something.
hunks.sol: As I watched the treasures, elixirs, and bank drafts pile up like a mountain, I finally realized something.

hunks.baseline: *Was this why he had stayed behind?*
hunks.sol: *Was this why he stayed?*

hunks.baseline: It was clearly a grand plan to make one big haul in his old age.
hunks.sol: It was clearly part of his grand plan to make one last big haul in his old age.

hunks.baseline: Eventually, after dealing with dozens of suckers, Jeok Cheongang opened his mouth.
hunks.sol: Eventually, after dealing with dozens of suckers, Jeok Cheongang spoke.

hunks.baseline: “Hm. This is quite a haul. Aren’t there any more?”
hunks.sol: “Hmm. This is quite a haul. Aren’t there any more?”

hunks.baseline: “Yes. It seems that everyone who was likely to come has already arrived.”
hunks.sol: “No. It seems everyone who was likely to come has already arrived.”

hunks.baseline: *Look at the greed on this old man.*
hunks.sol: *Just look at the greed on this old man.*

hunks.baseline: I subtly averted my gaze from Jeok Cheongang’s round eyes.
hunks.sol: Faced with Jeok Cheongang’s glare, I subtly averted my eyes.

hunks.baseline: “From where I’m standing, it doesn’t look like admiration.”
hunks.sol: “From where I’m standing, that doesn’t look like admiration.”

hunks.baseline: “I’m serious. There’s nothing wrong with having a lot of money.”
hunks.sol: “I’m serious. There’s nothing wrong with having a lot of wealth.”

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang let out a quiet laugh before casually tossing out another remark.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang let out a quiet laugh, then casually tossed out a remark.

hunks.baseline: “It’s completely useless to this old man, but it’s different for you. Whether you scatter it across the street or do anything else with it, I won’t care. Take it.”
hunks.sol: “It’s completely useless to this old man, but it’s different for you. Scatter it in the street or do whatever you want with it. I won’t care, so take it.”

hunks.baseline: I stared at Jeok Cheongang with a bewildered expression.
hunks.sol: I stared at Jeok Cheongang in bewilderment.

hunks.baseline: He had already helped me immensely. Naturally, I wanted to know why he was showing such excessive favor to me and the Jin Family of Taiyuan.
hunks.sol: He had already helped me immensely. Naturally, I couldn’t help wondering why he was showing such extraordinary favor to both me and the Jin Family of Taiyuan.

hunks.baseline: I watched Jeok Cheongang stagger away before turning my gaze back to the wine crock.
hunks.sol: I watched Jeok Cheongang stagger away, then turned my gaze back to the wine crock.

hunks.baseline: The moon was reflected in the crock, which he had not even emptied a quarter of.
hunks.sol: The moon was reflected in the wine. He had not even emptied a quarter of the crock.
[^1]: This puns on *jwa-wang-u-wang*, a Korean expression for being flustered or running around in confusion; *jwa* and *u* mean “left” and “right,” while *wang* means “king.”

hunks.baseline: [^1]: A dol hareubang is a stone guardian statue from Jeju Island. Folk beliefs associate touching its nose with fertility.
hunks.sol: [^2]: A dol hareubang is a stone guardian statue from Jeju Island. Folk beliefs associate touching its nose with fertility.
